image_description: A close-up view of an ornate, dark metal breastplate (part of a suit of armor). The surface is polished but appears aged or patinated, featuring embossed floral or scrollwork designs on the upper chest area. Visible components include the main torso plate, a pauldron (shoulder guard) on the left with layered lames, and rivets along the bottom edge. The lighting creates strong specular highlights, emphasizing the curvature and metallic texture.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from generic metal objects or other armor parts.
To analyze the realism of the metallic reflections, patina, and embossed textures for any AI-generation smoothing or noise artifacts.
To verify the physical connectivity between the breastplate, pauldrons, and rivets, ensuring no floating elements or fusion errors.
To ensure the embossed designs have correct depth relief and do not appear as flat textures painted on the surface.

focus_areas: Metallic reflectivity and specular highlight consistency
Physical plausibility of embossed pattern depth
Connectivity of pauldron to main breastplate
Absence of melting or warping in rigid metal structures
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between light and the embossed patterns. In AI images, embossed details often look like flat normal maps rather than having true geometric depth. Verify if the shadows within the embossed grooves are consistent with the global lighting direction. Also, check the rivets at the bottom; they should be distinct, 3D objects, not blurred blobs fused with the plate.
